### Findings

Across all available history for your authorized products (`[1, 2]`), the average difference between current catalogue `retail_price` and realized `sale_price` for `Complete` order items (`AVG(retail_price - sale_price)`) is [q1]:

| id | current_reference_gap |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 90.0 |
| 2 | 60.0 |

- Product `1` has a `current_reference_gap` of `90.0`, and product `2` has a `current_reference_gap` of `60.0` [q1].
- Metric and scope: `AVG(p.retail_price - i.sale_price)` on `order_items` joined to `products` filtered to `status = 'Complete'` within executor-enforced authorized product scope (`[1, 2]`), with no date filter applied [q1].

### Limitations

- The query only returned `id` and `current_reference_gap` for `Complete` items; item counts, `retail_price`, `sale_price` distributions (min/max), and date coverage were not queried [q1].
- Because `products.retail_price` represents the current catalogue price rather than historical list prices at order time, `current_reference_gap` does not measure historical discounts [q1].
- Non-`Complete` item statuses were excluded, currency units are not defined in the supplied schema/results, and no causal factors were measured [q1].

### Action items (proposed)

The following are proposed next analytical checks and have not been measured:
- Query `Complete` item counts alongside current `retail_price` and `MIN`/`MAX`/`AVG` `sale_price` by `id` to assess volume and realized price spread.
- Group `Complete` item counts and `current_reference_gap` by `created_at` date buckets to examine whether the gap varies over time.
- Inspect counts and `sale_price` across non-`Complete` statuses if needed for broader status comparison.
